testPressureDbar.description: Test pressure, implied unit deci-bar (×10) per Lexicon v1 integer-only rule (ADR-2605190900). 8125 = 812.5 bar gauge.

leakRateMicrolitrePerMin.description: Leak-rate ceiling, implied unit µL/min per Lexicon v1 integer-only rule. 1000 = 1.0 mL/min acceptance ceiling.
